bookings.title: Severe water leak under kitchen sink
bookings.description: The kitchen sink drain pipe has cracked and water is flooding into the wooden cupboards every time we run the tap. Urgent help needed.
bookings.additionalInstructions: Please ring the front bell; dog is kept locked inside.

attachments.caption: Cracked PVC siphon pipe under sink

bookings.aiSafetyWarning: Turn off the main isolation valve beneath the sink or the house main supply stopcock immediately to prevent water damage.
bookings.additionalCostNotes: Replaced flexible PVC trap and angle valve.

additionalChargeProposals.description: New high-pressure PVC siphon trap & angle stopcock

bookings.title: Main circuit breaker trips when ceiling fan turns on
bookings.description: Whenever we switch on the master bedroom ceiling fan, the main trip switch cuts off the power to the entire second floor.
bookings.aiSafetyWarning: Do not repeatedly force the breaker back on if it continues tripping. Leave the switch off until inspected.
bookings.additionalCostNotes: Replaced faulty ceiling fan capacitor and regulator.
bookings.completionNotes: Found shorted capacitor in the regulator box. Replaced capacitor and checked insulation resistance.

bookings.title: Living room AC blowing warm air and humming
bookings.description: Panasonic 18000 BTU inverter AC is running but not cooling at all. Air coming out is room temperature.
bookings.aiSafetyWarning: Turn the air conditioner unit off at the isolator switch to prevent compressor motor burnout.
